hints.title: Process a whole level
hints.body: Keep the current level's nodes together so their values can be appended as one list.

hints.title: Build the next level
hints.body: While visiting a level, collect the children of its nodes for the next pass.

hints.title: Queue order
hints.body: A queue naturally visits nodes left to right within each level.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
result = []
current = [root] if root else []
while current is not empty:
    values = []
    nextLevel = []
    for node in current:
        values.append(node.val)
        if node.left: nextLevel.append(node.left)
        if node.right: nextLevel.append(node.right)
    result.append(values)
    current = nextLevel
return result
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
